trajectory.content:
I can coordinate this, but I need the project resources/identifiers to perform the actions (Google Sheet, Trello board/cards, Slack channel, and vendor contact info or approval to choose vendors). Please provide the following so I can proceed and then I’ll carry out the booking, swag order, notifications, and Trello updates:

1) Google Sheets
- Share a link or the Spreadsheet ID for the event master sheet that contains the event details and recruiter assignments.
- If there are multiple worksheets, tell me which worksheet title to read (or confirm the sheet contains a worksheet named "Event Details" or "Recruiters").

2) Trello
- Trello board name or board link where the recruiters’ prep cards live.
- If possible, the exact Trello card names (or confirm cards are the recruiters’ full names). If you prefer, give the Trello list name where their cards are located.

3) Slack
- Channel name (e.g., #recruiting or #events) to post the coordination notification in, or the list of users to DM.

4) Gmail / Email details
- Sender email to use (if different from my default).
- Recipients to notify (e.g., recruiting@company.com) and any CC addresses (e.g., ops@company.com).
- Venue contact email and swag vendor email if you have preferred vendors. If you’d like me to choose vendors, give budget limits and any vendor preferences (local, lead time, vendor on approved vendor list).

5) Venue & Swag specifics / constraints (if any)
- Maximum acceptable venue capacity, preferred location, and booking budget.
- Swag items you want (e.g., "t-shirts", "lanyards", "stickers") and quantities, plus any imprint/brand file or required sizes/colors.
- Delivery address for swag (on-site day-of delivery or office address) and any lead-time constraints.

6) Booth roles and prep checklist
- If you have a preferred assignment method (e.g., rotate recruiters through “Greeter”, “Technical Q&A”, “Onsite Interviewer”), confirm role names and any rules (who can’t do which role).
- If you have a standard prep checklist to add to each Trello card, paste it or confirm I should use this default checklist:
  - Arrive 60 minutes before start
  - Bring business cards and resume folders
  - Set up laptop/tablet with recruiting slides
  - Collect candidate contact info
  - Log leads in CRM within 24 hours

If you prefer, I can:
- Read event & recruiter data from the provided Google Sheet,
- Book the venue and order swag from preferred or vetted vendors,
- Add a Trello comment on each recruiter’s prep card with their assigned booth role and the exact prep checklist (preserving verbatim values from the sheet),
- Send an email to recruiting and ops with the booking & swag confirmations,
- Post a summary to the specified Slack channel.

Once you supply the links/IDs / vendor info / role rules above, I’ll execute the steps and report back with the actions I performed and links/confirmation numbers.
